item.title: The Latest: US and Israel attack Iran as Trump says US begins ‘major combat operations’
item.description: The U.S. and Israel have launched strikes on Tehran, and President Donald Trump says the U.S. is starting major combat operations against Iran.

item.title: Read President Trump’s statement on Iran in full
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said in an 8-minute video posted on his Truth Social that the U.S. has begun “major combat operations in Iran.”

item.title: Pet of Week: Zi
item.description: This week's Pet of the Week from Tipton County Animal Shelter is Zi!

item.title: Israeli officials say Iran’s Supreme Leader Khamenei is dead. No word from US or Iran
item.description: Israeli officials told The Associated Press that Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei is dead.

item.title: Actor Shia LaBeouf arrested again on battery charge in New Orleans
item.description: Actor Shia LaBeouf, who was arrested and charged with battery after police say he punched several people outside a New Orleans bar earlier this month, was arrested again on Saturday and charged with one additional count of simple battery, court records show.

item.title: Fire teams in Gibson County respond to grass fire
item.description: According to officials from the City of Gibson Fire Department, a joint effort Saturday morning with Gibson County Fire Department Stations 2 and Station 6 allowed for fire teams to quickly contain a grass fire outside of Trenton.

item.title: New Jackson Madison County Voters Council presents town hall
item.description: The New Jackson Madison County Voters Council presented a town hall event Saturday.

item.title: Wellpoint hosts its Winter Academy Workshop
item.description: Wellpoint Tennessee partnered with the Jackson-Madison County School System, Family Resource Center and many other community partner organizations to host its Winter Academy Workshop.

item.title: Workshop provides teachers with new classroom skills
item.description: Replenishing the Teacher’s Toolbox Workshop took place today in Jackson.

item.title: The Latest: Trump says Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei is dead
item.description: President Donald Trump says Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei has been killed in a major attack on Iran launched by Israel and the United States.
